SEARCH
Module org.maxicp
Package org.maxicp.search.blackbox

Class BlackBoxSearch

java.lang.Object
org.maxicp.search.blackbox.BlackBoxSearch
All Implemented Interfaces:
SearchMethod
public class BlackBoxSearch extends Object implements SearchMethod
Commercial-solver-style black-box search orchestrator for modeling-level CP and scheduling problems.

Implements SearchMethod so it can be used as a drop-in replacement for DFSearch inside model.runCP(cp -> ...) via cp.blackBoxSearch(), or directly on a ModelDispatcher via model.blackBoxSearch(), model.solve(...), and model.optimize(...).

Automatically discovers both integer/boolean variables (IntExpression) and scheduling interval variables (IntervalVar) from the model when not explicitly provided.

      public SearchStatistics optimizeSubjectTo(Objective objToTighten, Predicate<SearchStatistics> limit, Runnable subjectTo)
      Description copied from interface: SearchMethod
      Executes a closure prior to effectively starting a branch and bound depth first search with a given objective to optimize and a given predicate called at each node to stop the search when it becomes true. The state manager saves the state before executing the closure and restores it after the search. Any InconsistencyException that may be thrown when executing the closure is also catched.

      optimizeSubjectTo in interface SearchMethod

      an object with the statistics on the search
